description: The.44 Henry, also known as the.44 Rimfire, the.44 Long Rimfire, or the 11x23mmR (11x23mm Rimmed) in Europe, is a rimfire rifle and handgun cartridge.  Mostly known for its use in the Henry Rifle and the Winchester Model 1866, this round has fallen into obscurity after being passed by the.44-40 Winchester.
